posts.author: GrumblingBeardling
posts.body:
Hey! So I'm relativly new to rpg maker and have been messing around with my own custom tile set, however I find 2 recuring issue, unexplainable (to me at least) transparent pixels that will overlap onto the tile below (e.g, grass tile, with a fence tile on top, but when I place the fence, there is a chance that a pixels width of a side will go transparent all the way down, becoming empty). The secondary issue I suspect may be a skill issue but when I try and aligne my 48x48 tiles in a grid with 48x48 sized squares, its rather difficult? As in they often will be slightly off one way or another, usually only by a pixel, but in some cases that'll be clear if its a part of a larger structure or for example a grass tile, needing a few minor adjustments each (which means I gotta export and replace the tileset etc over and over), any tips with that too would be great!
For refrence I use Asperite and Gimp for making and gridding the tiles. Also, some images are attached below, many thanks!
